verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation of facility physical-security controls, staff background screening, or encryption of mail scans. The nearest items are adjacent features: secure shredding of physical mail, secure upload of onboarding ID documents, audit logs, and roles and permissions. None of these documents how mail is physically secured or how scans are digitally protected.

support.subject: As an operator, the provider documents how mail is physically secured and digitally protected — facility controls, staff screening, encryption of scans
